title: v04 endpoint-method funnel rollup (draft-not-frozen)
$comment: No network resolution required. Counts and rates are derived from immutable slot records. JSON Schema does not enforce arithmetic; runner and independent auditor must enforce x-invariants. This schema is a draft, not a test result.
x-invariants: P = E + originalIneligible + eligibilityUnresolved + upstreamMissing + notScreened
Each rate equals its named ratio; zero denominator is null, never zero
Each planned dataset/source/task/method slot is unique; R/G are masks on one proposal, not two independent proposals
Core methods share original eligibility and public preparation; unsupported methods do not reduce E/Q
Formal target P=768 per core method per endpoint; deviations require visible protocol/run status and retained missing slots
Acceptance is locked before private evaluation; nonaccepted slots never have S/W/U_A
Confirmed violation dominates unknown for accepted W; preserve co-occurring uncertainty separately
Eligibility reason precedence: not screened if never attempted; missing source if attempted upstream without source; otherwise confirmed ineligible dominates unresolved, else eligible
Eligibility, preparation and proposal not-executed counts remain in P; completed means terminal ledger, not every slot performed
No pooled DEV/PILOT/FORMAL or pooled G/R efficacy denominators
Cluster unit is highest dependent brief/family level, never individual task
